queries.query: How can uploaded names containing parent directory components be prevented from escaping their storage directory?
How should Django validate an uploaded filename before storage so parent directories cannot escape the upload root?
How should a Windows network share path be rejected when an older Python absolute-path check misses it?
Werkzeug safe_join on Windows Python before 3.11 can miss UNC paths. What extra condition is needed?
Can user-selected date units in Django date extraction and truncation inject structural SQL arguments?
Untrusted kind or lookup_name is passed to Trunc and Extract date functions; how should structural SQL arguments be constrained?
How should user-controlled sorting fields be validated when a deprecated Django alias path bypasses checks?
A deprecated raw column alias path in QuerySet.order_by bypasses validation despite emitting a warning.
How can bracketed URL hosts cause parser disagreement and requests to an internal network?
urllib.parse accepts bracketed hosts that are not IPv6 or IPvFuture, causing parser disagreement and conditional SSRF.
Can a user-supplied branch name become a process option even when subprocess uses an argument list without a shell?
Mercurial checkout receives an untrusted branch argument and interprets it as a flag even with shell=False.
How can restoring an exception from stored task queue error metadata invoke an arbitrary function?
Celery result metadata selects a callable as an exception constructor; validate BaseException subclass before invocation.
How should a machine learning web service reject pickle data from external HTTP requests before deserialization?
BentoML entry service should reject pickle media type at the public request boundary while preserving ordinary JSON requests.
Can checking only an extraction directory string prefix allow escape into a sibling directory sharing that prefix?
Oracle GIS tolerance is supplied by an external user and interpolated into SQL instead of passed as a numeric Value expression.
How can leading zeros in IPv4 octets cause inconsistent octal interpretation and bypass address validation?
An urllib3 PoolManager redirect-disable policy is lost through retry handling; SSRF mitigation must apply at the effective request layer.
